test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rats are roads.

All roads are bags.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bags are rats.

II. Some bags are rats.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51613653b9c5cc87a7554626535a5a994a79d92ab8ea7819267b0dd48dfe0b0d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bags are rats → Does not follow (As all roads are bags and all rats are roads. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some bags are rats → Follow (As all roads are bags and all rats are roads. So, whole rats comes in roads which whole comes in bags therefore it is definitely true)

∴ Here, Only II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows **".
